title: This free Claude Code skill copies any animation
sources: https://github.com/NiazMorshed2007/reanimate (README + repo page, read 2026-11-23: 2.3k stars; re-checked 2026-11-24: 2.4k stars, 212 forks, MIT, Claude Code skill, record/spec/build/verify loop, CSS/Framer Motion/GSAP/three.js, Vercel Toolbar 417 of 417 frames identical, inputs: live site, screen recording, mp4, gif, Lottie, 'clone X and add Y')

scenes.visual: Skill card (repo-style: owner/reanimate, 'A Claude Code skill') with a green FREE sticker popping on 'free'; cursor drifts to the Star button.

scenes.text: copies any animation you see online,
scenes.visual: Card shrinks up (zoom morph) while a grid of small animated UI tiles ripples in: spinners, toggles, cards, bouncing dots.
Film strip of 6 frames of one card animation sliding left, each frame numbered f1..f6.

scenes.text: and then proves the copy moves the same.
scenes.visual: stripe.com original and reanimate copy as two full cards side by side (real README demo), tilting identically under the same pointer path; delta 0.4 px badge and MOVES THE SAME on same.

scenes.text: It already has 2.4K stars on GitHub.
scenes.visual: Dark 'GitHub stars' widget: counter rolls 0 -> 2.4K landing on the word, gold line chart rising to a glowing dot.
Light act opens with an iris from the star: repo card 'NiazMorshed2007 / reanimate', description, tags claude-code, animation, motion, MIT.

scenes.text: Point it at a live site, a screen recording, a GIF or a Lottie file.
scenes.visual: 2x2 input cards (Live site, Screen recording, GIF, Lottie) - each lights up with a coral outline and tick on its word.

scenes.text: It records the motion in a headless browser,
scenes.visual: Browser window with a red REC dot; below it a strip of captured frames filling in left to right.

scenes.text: writes a spec for every element,
scenes.visual: Spec table: rows element / property / from -> to / easing (card, opacity, 0 -> 1, ease-out ...) typing in row by row.

scenes.text: builds it in CSS, Framer Motion or GSAP,
scenes.visual: Code editor typing a keyframes block; three pills CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP pop on their words.

scenes.text: then films its own copy and measures the difference.
scenes.visual: Before/after slider wiping between the original and the copy card (real README demo) over a pixel-difference meter counting 12.4% -> 0.0%.

scenes.text: On Vercel's toolbar it matched 417 of 417 frames.
scenes.visual: Big counter '417 / 417 frames identical' with a frame-by-frame check grid filling green.

scenes.text: But don't stop at a copy.
scenes.visual: Black iris into a dark terminal: '/reanimate the hero on stripe.com' typed, then struck through with a red X badge.

scenes.text: Ask it to clone this and add that, and build your own on top.
scenes.visual: Cream iris: stepper Clone -> Add your twist -> Ship, with three prompt chips: 'clone this', 'match it exactly', 'clone X and add Y'.

scenes.text: Comment ANIMATE and I'll send you the link.
scenes.visual: Dark profile card + comments sheet: a comment 'ANIMATE' pops in, reply 'Sent! Check your DMs', DM notification drops in with github.com/NiazMorshed2007/reanimate.

music.why: uplifting product film; earshot read the C minor score as sad
